description: Send a new Canvas Inbox message, e.g. to a professor. Use find_recipients first to get recipient IDs. [IRREVERSIBLE: call without confirm=true first to preview, then re-call with confirm=true.]

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute. Omit or set false to get a dry-run preview first.

separate_threads.description: Send individually rather than as a group thread
